field_text_formatted.value: On druxtjs.org, Drupal's Purge module sends that POST whenever a cache tag is invalidated, so a saved menu link reaches the frontend on the next request. It clears Druxt's cache only, so a CDN in front of Drupal needs its own purger, and a drush cr doesn't send it.
